verdict: Ads are effectively paused and lead tracking needs an immediate fix.
narrative: In the last 28 days, Meta registered zero tracked leads against $57.43 in spend — but this reflects a broken lead-tracking setup, not an absence of interest: your CRM shows 171 contacts and 9 opportunities created in the same window. Separately, paid campaigns have had no active daily spend for roughly the last 25 days, meaning ads have been functionally off. On the organic side, your Google Business Profile drove 158 actions this period — 67 calls, 62 direction requests, and 29 website clicks — but that activity dropped 61% in the most recent 7 days as local search impressions declined. Lead event tracking is being repaired so the next report reflects true results, and campaign activity is being reviewed to restore consistent spend.

highlights.phrase: Google Business Profile actions this period — calls, direction requests, and website clicks combined
new opportunities created in your CRM this period, with $385.60 in tracked pipeline value
drop in Google Business Profile actions in the last 7 days, driven by falling local search impressions

watch_item.issue: Lead tracking on Meta ads is recording zero conversions despite real CRM activity, making it impossible to measure paid performance accurately.
watch_item.fix: Conversion tracking is being repaired now so that leads are counted correctly going forward.
